sec: Vitamin D action in jejunum, anti-proliferative effect and PTH basics · p870

items.q: Vitamin D increases Ca2+ absorption predominantly in the:
items.exp: ↑ Ca2+ absorption predominantly in jejunum (TRPV5/6, calbindin-D, NCX1, PMCA1b). (Book p870)

items.q: VDR has anti-proliferative (protective against malignancy) effects on:
items.exp: VDR anti-proliferative on skin, breast, prostate — vit D protective against malignancies. (Book p870)

items.q: PTH is an ___ amino-acid molecule; its related peptide (PTHrP) has ___ aa.
items.exp: PTH = 84 aa; PTH-related peptide = 139 aa. (Book p870)
